brief_summary: Monotherapy with DPP-IV inhibitors, SGLT-2 inhibitors or insulin secretagogues frequently failed to maintain blood glucose in patients with type 2 diabtes. It was critical to determine which was more suitable of acarbose versus metformin plus pioglitazone.
brief_title: Effect of Acarbose and Mixture of Pioglitazone and Metformin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

official_title: Effect of Acarbose and Fixed Mixture of Pioglitazone and Metformin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Receiving Anti-diabetic Monotherapy
